carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal feature is visible along the superior lateral flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from high-intensity (dorsal side) to low-intensity shadow (ventral side).

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density cluster of smaller high-luminance blobs is visible on the proximal and medial surfaces of the visible pectoral fin.
